name: Mariel Santos Cruz
headline: Customer Success Specialist
summary: Customer Success professional with 4 years of experience managing client onboarding, retention, and support operations for SaaS companies. Skilled in using CRM and helpdesk tools to streamline customer journeys and improve satisfaction scores. Passionate about building long-term client relationships and driving product adoption.

responsibilities: Manage onboarding process for new enterprise clients, ensuring smooth product adoption
Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of 40+ accounts
Monitor customer health scores using CRM and proactively address churn risks
Collaborate with product and support teams to resolve escalated tickets via Zendesk
Conduct quarterly business reviews to identify upsell opportunities
Guided new customers through initial product setup and training sessions
Responded to customer inquiries and resolved technical issues using Zendesk
Maintained accurate customer records and interaction history in CRM system
Assisted in creating onboarding documentation and FAQ resources
Handled inbound customer queries for a US-based telecom client
Logged and tracked customer issues in internal CRM software
Achieved consistent monthly customer satisfaction targets
